title: THE PIXEL BARRELS AND THE PROPS SHEET
why: Job 86e ship 2: with the pixel look on the four barrel bodies (red, shock, acid, cryo) are one cached sprite per blink state through pixWrap, while the pulse on the floor, the lid glow, the idle sparks and the pools stay live. It also adds the props sheet to ?pixbench (containers, bodies, wrecks, barrels drawn by their real painters).
now: With the pixel look on, explosive barrels draw as crisp pixel sprites; the floor pulse, sparks and glow still move. A props sheet is added to the pixel bench page. With the look off nothing changes.
